title: Lil' Jammers, Caregiver & Child
description: 9:00AM – Register Here Starting August 11! 10:00AM – Register Here Starting August 11! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 27 – November 22, 2025 [SKIP October 11] Saturdays | 9:00 – 9:45 am OR 10:00 – 10:45 am| Ages 1-3 Aurora Town Square – Program Room A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Toddlers will develop a foundational knowledge and an overall love of music as they learn through expressive music making and movement. Using creative and engaging music activities, youngsters will explore rhythm, pitch, melody and listening activities. From singing songs together and exploring instruments, to learning how to keep a steady beat and enjoying free and group dances, this is the perfect introductory class for youngsters. Lil’ Jammers requires parent/guardian participation.
